before: Paid opt-in, enabled only by the literal query value 'true' (allow_long_transcription=true). Defaults to false when omitted; other values do not enable paid mode. By default, successful AI transcription of videos up to 120 seconds (two minutes, inclusive) costs a flat 1 credit per request. Over 120 seconds, videos cannot be AI-transcribed by default. Set allow_long_transcription=true to opt into paid AI with no fixed duration cap: ALL successful AI transcriptions in this mode cost 10 credits per started minute, including short videos: 10 * ceil(duration_seconds / 60). For example, 177 seconds costs 30 credits and an opted-in 60 seconds costs 10 credits. Empty AI results and errors cost 0 credits for AI transcription. This flag does not force AI and does not enable transcription or AI fallback by itself. Keep get_transcript=true or use_ai_as_fallback=true where required by the endpoint. Returned native captions still cost 1 credit on dedicated transcript routes, even for long videos with this flag; on detail routes they leave the base price unchanged. These routes remain synchronous. Allow at least 30 seconds on your client. Paid long transcription can exceed resource limits or timeouts, so successful transcription of long videos is not guaranteed.
after: Opt into long AI transcription only with the literal query value 'true' (allow_long_transcription=true). Defaults to false; other values do not enable the mode. By default, AI transcription is limited to videos up to 120 seconds (inclusive). Enable this flag to remove that fixed duration cap, including for short videos. The flag does not force AI or enable transcription or AI fallback by itself: keep get_transcript=true or use_ai_as_fallback=true where required. Native captions can still be returned instead of AI transcription. These routes remain synchronous. Allow at least 30 seconds on your client. Long transcription can exceed resource limits or timeouts, so success is not guaranteed.
